verdicts.originalText: Sacramental Shower lifetime not rendered on the timeline. The entity is touch-triggered (party members bounce, opponents explode) and its duration isn't modelled in gcsim or available from a canonical source — surfacing a fabricated window would mislead.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the Sacramental Shower summon. Its lifetime isn't known, so no window is shown for it.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate omission (a summon whose duration has no source), so rewrite not delete. Compressed to the stock not-modeled pattern; the core claim (summon lifetime absent from the timeline, because unknown) survives. Stripped the banned word 'gcsim', fixed 'modelled'->'modeled', and cut the kit-explanation (touch-trigger bounce/explode) and the curator fabrication-rationale per the no-kit-explanation and source-demotion rules.

verdicts.originalText: Shield of Sacred Favor absorbs Hydro DMG 250% more effectively (not shown as a number). When the shield breaks, it re-forms by spending a Benison stack (up to 4 per burst) — the timeline shows only the initial shield window, not any regenerated shields.
verdicts.proposedText: The shield absorbs Hydro DMG at 250% effectiveness, which the shown window doesn't reflect. Only the initial shield is shown; when it breaks it re-forms by spending a Benison stack (up to 4 per cast), which the timeline omits.
verdicts.rationale: Both gaps are real (no per-element shield-efficiency primitive; shield shatter-by-damage and its regeneration are on the CANNOT list — expiry is scheduled by design), so rewrite not implementDelete. Compression-only: aligned '250% more effectively' to the description's exact 'with 250% effectiveness' wording (the source of truth) to avoid propagating a possible overstatement, and de-named 'per burst' to 'per cast' since the panel already shows the Burst chip. All three original claims preserved.
